hero.title: Serving Nostalgia Since 1920
hero.subtitle: Experience over a century of authentic South Indian delicacies, cherished by generations at Central Tiffin Room.

about.title: About Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, fondly known as CTR, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of timeless South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and proudly carried forward by the Poojari family, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. If there’s one thing that mirrors the Central Tiffin Room brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years.
